meeting_scene: As the meeting began, Priya leaned forward in her seat with an air of quiet confidence, stating "I'm pleased to report on our latest sales numbers - a 10% increase from last quarter." The team's attention was drawn to Alex's note-taker's screen as they efficiently captured key metrics. Meanwhile, Vikram rubbed the back of his neck slightly at stress level reminders flashing across their display; he cleared throat and asked about upcoming project milestones before Jordan spoke up with an issue that caused him a raised brow:  it seemed like some teams were behind schedule on meeting team-building goals but Riya jumped in quickly to address concerns.
